name: Miyashita Kurumi
source:
Like Kanata, she is a girl whose “time” has stopped due to an accident, but mentally, she is a bit mature and enlightened. She also shows a slightly frightened side due to her special circumstances.

She trusts the protagonist, calls him “Sensei”, and receives treatment from him. She puts her sister first and acts accordingly. She is characterized by her wavy blond hair and pale emerald eyes.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=69721&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
